title: Drug Classes: Your BC Drugs and Your Patient's Pill Bottles
next: Chapter 8: Vascular Access and Medication Administration

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already know ASA for chest pain, salbutamol for wheeze, naloxone for opioids. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Sort drugs into classes by body system and mechanism
  2. Place every BC drug in its class, and know which are PCP-only
  3. Read your patient's own medications as clues and warnings

Textbook: Chapter 7, PDF pages 496–522
slides.say: Welcome to the last lesson of Chapter 7. As an EMR, you already know a few drugs well: ASA for chest pain, salbutamol for wheezing, naloxone for an opioid overdose. Now that you're a PCP, you'll give drugs from new classes, and you'll meet patients who take many drugs you will never give. Don't try to memorize every name. Learn the classes instead: what each class does, and what it does to your patient. Today we'll cover three things: how drugs are grouped, where each of your BC drugs fits, including the seven PCP-only drugs, and how to read your patient's medications as clues to their history and as warnings for your treatment.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎来到第 7 章的最后一课。当 EMR 时，你已经熟悉几种药：胸痛用 ASA，喘鸣用沙丁胺醇，阿片类过量用纳洛酮。现在你是 PCP，会给新类别的药，也会遇到吃着很多你永远不会给的药的病人。不要试图背每一个药名，而是学类别：每一类药做什么、会对你的病人有什么影响。今天讲三件事：药物怎样分类；你的每种 BC 药属于哪一类，包括那七种 PCP 专用药；以及怎样把病人的用药当作病史线索和治疗警示。

slides.title: Pain relief: analgesics and naloxone
slides.body:
ClassHow it worksBC example
Salicylateblocks COX, fewer prostaglandinsASA
NSAIDblocks COX: pain, fever, swellingibuprofen
Para-aminophenolpain and feveracetaminophen
Opioid agonistturns on opioid receptorsnone in BC scope
Opioid antagonistblocks opioid receptorsnaloxone

Score pain 0–10 before and after treatment, and document it.
slides.say: Let's start with pain. The non-opioid painkillers work by reducing prostaglandins, the chemicals behind pain, fever, and swelling, through an enzyme called COX. This group includes ASA, ibuprofen, which is an NSAID, and acetaminophen. Opioid agonists, like fentanyl and morphine, are the book's most common prehospital painkillers, but they are not in BC EMR or PCP scope. Naloxone is an opioid antagonist: it takes the receptor without switching it on, so the opioid can't act. BC also has two inhaled pain medications, Entonox and methoxyflurane, for all licence levels. One PCP detail: in BC, using acetaminophen or ibuprofen for fever is marked PCP. Always score pain from zero to ten, before and after.
slides.sayZh: 先说止痛。非阿片类止痛药通过一种叫 COX 的酶减少前列腺素——前列腺素是引起疼痛、发热和肿胀的化学物质。这一组包括 ASA、属于 NSAID 的布洛芬，以及对乙酰氨基酚。阿片受体激动剂，比如芬太尼和吗啡，是书里院前最常用的止痛药，但不在 BC EMR/PCP 范围内。纳洛酮是阿片受体拮抗剂：它占住受体却不激活，阿片类药物就无法起作用。BC 还有两种吸入止痛药——笑气（Entonox）和甲氧氟烷，所有执照级别都能用。一个 PCP 细节：在 BC，用对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬退热标为 PCP 级别。止痛前后都要用零到十分评估疼痛。

slides.title: Clot drugs: four different jobs
slides.body:
ClassJobExamples
Antiplateletstops more platelets clumpingASA, clopidogrel
Anticoagulantstops clots formingheparin, warfarin, DOACs
Fibrinolyticdissolves a formed clottPA, tenecteplase
Antifibrinolyticstops clots breaking downTXA (PCP)

ASA acts on COX-1 and platelets. Ibuprofen leans to COX-2, so it can't replace ASA in chest pain.
slides.say: Think of clot drugs as four different jobs. Antiplatelet drugs stop more platelets from clumping, but they don't break up a clot. ASA is the key one; it reduces heart muscle damage in acute coronary syndrome. Anticoagulants, like heparin, warfarin, and the newer direct oral anticoagulants, stop clots from forming. On a trauma call, they also block the clotting your patient needs, so always ask about them. Fibrinolytics dissolve a clot that has already formed. And TXA, your PCP drug, does the opposite: it stops clots from breaking down, which helps a bleeding patient. Finally, ASA works mainly on COX-1 and the platelets, while ibuprofen leans toward COX-2, so ibuprofen cannot replace ASA for chest pain.
slides.sayZh: 把凝血相关的药记成四种不同的「工作」。抗血小板药阻止更多血小板聚集，但不会打散已有的血块。ASA 是最关键的一个，它能减少急性冠脉综合征的心肌损伤。抗凝药，比如肝素、华法林和较新的直接口服抗凝药，阻止血栓形成；在创伤现场，它们也会阻碍病人需要的凝血，所以一定要问。纤溶药溶解已经形成的血栓。而你的 PCP 药 TXA 正好相反：它阻止血块被分解，帮助出血的病人止血。最后，ASA 主要作用于 COX-1 和血小板，布洛芬更偏向 COX-2，所以胸痛时布洛芬不能代替 ASA。

slides.title: Adrenergic receptors: alpha and beta
slides.body:
ReceptorWhen stimulated
Alpha-1vessels constrict, BP rises
Alpha-2controls norepinephrine release
Beta-1heart: faster, stronger, faster conduction
Beta-2airways and vessels dilate
  • Epinephrine: alpha and beta: BP, heart, airways
  • Salbutamol: mainly beta-2: airways
  • Beta blockers: block beta-1: slower heart, lower BP
slides.say: The sympathetic system's adrenergic receptors come in four main types. Alpha-1 tightens blood vessels and raises blood pressure. Alpha-2 controls how much norepinephrine is released. Beta-1 acts on the heart: faster rate, stronger squeeze, faster conduction. Beta-2 opens the airways and relaxes blood vessels. A simple memory aid: you have one heart and two lungs, so beta-1 is the heart and beta-2 is the lungs. Now link this to your drugs. Epinephrine stimulates alpha and beta receptors, so in anaphylaxis it supports the blood pressure, the heart, and the airways. Salbutamol works mainly on beta-2, opening the airways with less strain on the heart. Beta blockers, which many patients take, block beta-1.
slides.sayZh: 交感神经的肾上腺素能受体主要有四种。α1 让血管收缩、血压升高。α2 调控去甲肾上腺素的释放量。β1 作用于心脏：心率更快、收缩更有力、传导更快。β2 打开气道、放松血管。一个简单记法：你有一颗心、两片肺，所以 β1 管心脏，β2 管肺。再联系到你的药：肾上腺素同时兴奋 α 和 β 受体，所以在过敏性休克中它同时撑住血压、心脏和气道。沙丁胺醇主要作用于 β2，打开气道，对心脏的负担更小。很多病人吃的 β 受体阻滞剂则阻断 β1。

slides.q: A 67-year-old who takes metoprolol, a beta blocker, has a bleeding leg wound. He is pale and sweaty, BP 86/60, pulse 68. What explains the pulse?
options: He can't be in shock with a pulse of 68
The beta blocker can block the fast heart rate of shock
slides.say: Let's apply this. A sixty-seven-year-old man who takes metoprolol, a beta blocker, has a bleeding leg wound. He's pale and sweaty, with a blood pressure of eighty-six over sixty and a pulse of sixty-eight. What explains the pulse? A, he can't be in shock with a pulse of sixty-eight. B, the beta blocker can block the fast heart rate of shock. C, pain is slowing his heart. D, bleeding always slows the heart. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来应用一下。一位六十七岁男性，平时吃美托洛尔（一种 β 受体阻滞剂），腿部伤口出血。他面色苍白、出冷汗，血压八十六比六十，脉搏六十八。怎么解释这个脉搏？A 脉搏六十八就不可能是休克；B β 受体阻滞剂可能挡住了休克时的心跳加快；C 疼痛让他心跳变慢；D 出血总会让心跳变慢。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. Shock normally drives the heart rate up through beta-1 receptors, but a beta blocker occupies those receptors, so the expected fast pulse may never appear. A is the dangerous trap: his pale, sweaty skin and low blood pressure say shock. C is wrong because pain usually speeds the heart up. D is wrong; bleeding normally causes a fast pulse. Always check the medication list before you trust a normal heart rate.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。休克通常通过 β1 受体让心率加快，但 β 受体阻滞剂占住了这些受体，预期的快脉搏可能根本不出现。A 是危险的陷阱：苍白、出冷汗和低血压都说明是休克。C 错，因为疼痛通常让心跳加快。D 错，出血通常引起脉搏加快。相信一个「正常」心率之前，先看看病人的用药清单。

slides.title: Breathing drugs
slides.body:
• Airway muscle: parasympathetic tightens, beta-2 opens
  • Non-selective stimulants also push the heart: more O₂ demand
  • Selective beta-2 agonist: salbutamol (all levels)
  • Anticholinergic: ipratropium blocks the tightening (PCP)
  • Corticosteroid: dexamethasone calms inflammation (PCP)
  • Oxygen is a drug too, with indications and side effects
slides.say: Breathing drugs make sense once you know the wiring. The parasympathetic side tightens the airway muscle, and the sympathetic side, through beta-2 receptors, relaxes it. Drugs that stimulate all the adrenergic receptors also push the heart harder, and that raises oxygen demand in a patient who is already short of oxygen. That's why a selective beta-2 agonist like salbutamol is preferred. As a PCP you add two new classes. Ipratropium is an anticholinergic: it blocks the parasympathetic signal that tightens the airway, and in BC it's a single dose, given with salbutamol, never alone. Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid that calms airway inflammation.
slides.sayZh: 知道了「线路」，呼吸系统用药就好理解了。副交感神经让气道平滑肌收紧，交感神经通过 β2 受体让它放松。兴奋所有肾上腺素能受体的药也会让心脏更卖力，在本来就缺氧的病人身上增加耗氧。所以首选沙丁胺醇这样的选择性 β2 激动剂。作为 PCP，你多了两类药。异丙托溴铵是抗胆碱药：它阻断让气道收紧的副交感信号；在 BC 只给一次，要和沙丁胺醇一起用，不能单用。地塞米松是皮质类固醇，能平息气道炎症。

slides.title: Heart and BP drugs at home
slides.body:
ClassWhat to expect
Beta blockerslow pulse; may hide shock
Calcium channel blockerlower BP, slower conduction
ACE inhibitorlower BP (less angiotensin II)
Diureticless fluid; loop type can drop potassium
Digoxinnarrow safety margin; toxicity is easy

Chronotropic = rate. Inotropic = force. Dromotropic = conduction speed.
slides.say: Many patients take heart and blood pressure drugs. None of these are on your BC list, but they change what you see. Three words: chronotropic means heart rate, inotropic means the force of contraction, and dromotropic means conduction speed. Beta blockers slow the heart and can hide the fast pulse of shock. Calcium channel blockers lower the blood pressure and slow conduction. ACE inhibitors lower the pressure by blocking the making of angiotensin two. Diuretics remove salt and water, and loop diuretics can drop the potassium. Digoxin has a very narrow safety margin, so toxicity happens easily. Nearly one in four Canadian adults has high blood pressure, so you'll see these bottles often.
slides.sayZh: 很多病人在吃心脏和降压药。这些药都不在你的 BC 药单上，但会改变你看到的表现。三个词：变时（chronotropic）指心率，变力（inotropic）指收缩力，变传导（dromotropic）指传导速度。β 受体阻滞剂让心跳变慢，可能掩盖休克时的快脉搏。钙通道阻滞剂降低血压、减慢传导。ACE 抑制剂通过阻止生成血管紧张素 II 来降压。利尿剂排出盐和水，袢利尿剂可能让血钾降低。地高辛安全范围很窄，很容易中毒。将近四分之一的加拿大成年人有高血压，所以你会经常看到这些药瓶。

slides.title: Nausea, allergy, and a nitro warning
slides.body:
• Dimenhydrinate: antihistamine (H1 blocker), stops nausea (PCP)
  • Ondansetron: antiemetic (PCP)
  • Diphenhydramine: antihistamine for allergic reactions (PCP)
  • PDE inhibitors (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil) dilate vessels
  • With nitroglycerin: severe, hard-to-reverse hypotension

Always ask about erectile dysfunction drugs before nitro.
slides.say: Now three of your new PCP drugs, plus one big warning. Dimenhydrinate is technically an antihistamine and a sedative. It blocks histamine at H1 receptors, and it has a strong anti-nausea effect. Ondansetron is another antiemetic, a drug against nausea and vomiting. Diphenhydramine is an antihistamine you'll give in allergic reactions, as an add-on to epinephrine. Now the warning. Phosphodiesterase inhibitors, like sildenafil, vardenafil, and tadalafil, are taken for erectile dysfunction, and they dilate blood vessels. Combined with nitroglycerin, they can cause severe hypotension that is hard to reverse. Patients may not mention them, so always ask before you give nitro, in private if needed.
slides.sayZh: 接下来是三种新的 PCP 药，外加一个重要警示。茶苯海明严格说属于抗组胺药和镇静药，它在 H1 受体上阻断组胺，止吐效果很强。昂丹司琼是另一种止吐药，用来对付恶心和呕吐。苯海拉明是抗组胺药，你会在过敏反应中把它作为肾上腺素的辅助用药。再说警示：磷酸二酯酶抑制剂，比如西地那非、伐地那非和他达拉非，用来治疗勃起功能障碍，会扩张血管。和硝酸甘油一起用，可能导致严重且难以纠正的低血压。病人未必会主动说，所以给硝酸甘油前一定要问，必要时私下问。

slides.title: Other drugs on your patients' lists
slides.body:
• Benzodiazepines, sedatives: boost GABA, slow the brain
  • Stimulants (amphetamines, cocaine): fast pulse, high BP, seizures
  • Antipsychotics: odd face and tongue movements, low BP standing
  • Tricyclic antidepressants: fast pulse, low BP standing
  • Diabetes pills, insulin, anticoagulants, inhalers
  • Antibiotics: you don't give them, but ask about allergies
slides.say: Here are other classes you'll find in your patients' homes. None are BC drugs for you to give, but they explain what you see. Benzodiazepines and other sedatives boost GABA, a calming messenger in the brain. Stimulants, like amphetamines and cocaine, raise the pulse and blood pressure and can cause seizures. Antipsychotics can cause odd movements of the face, lips, and tongue, and low blood pressure when the patient stands up. Tricyclic antidepressants can cause a fast pulse and low pressure on standing. And while you never give antibiotics, always ask about antibiotic allergies, because many patients have them.
slides.sayZh: 下面是你在病人家里会看到的其他药物类别。它们都不是你要给的 BC 药，但能解释你看到的表现。苯二氮卓类和其他镇静药增强 GABA——大脑里一种起抑制、镇静作用的信使。兴奋剂，比如苯丙胺和可卡因，会让脉搏加快、血压升高，还可能引起抽搐。抗精神病药可能引起面部、嘴唇和舌头的怪异动作，以及站起来时低血压。三环类抗抑郁药可能引起脉搏快和站立时低血压。抗生素你从来不给，但一定要问抗生素过敏，因为很多病人都有。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: new tools in each protocol
slides.body:
From the BC protocols. Nausea–vomiting is a PCP-only protocol.

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Asthma/COPD: salbutamol
  • Anaphylaxis: epinephrine IM
  • Chest pain: ASA, nitroglycerin
  • Low sugar: glucose gel; EMR gives glucagon
  • Opioid overdose: ventilate, naloxone
  • Shock: control bleeding, keep warm, oxygen

PCP adds

  • Asthma/COPD: ipratropium, dexamethasone, IM epi if severe
  • Anaphylaxis: IV fluids, salbutamol, diphenhydramine
  • Chest pain: IV line, dimenhydrinate for nausea
  • Low sugar: IV D10W; glucagon only if no IV
  • Opioid overdose: IV naloxone if still apneic
  • Shock: IV fluids, TXA
slides.say: Here is the EMR versus PCP picture, protocol by protocol. Left is every licence level; right is what the PCP adds. In asthma or COPD, you add ipratropium, dexamethasone, and IM epinephrine for severe disease. In anaphylaxis, you add IV fluids if the patient stays hypotensive, salbutamol for bronchospasm after epinephrine, and diphenhydramine. In chest pain, an IV line and dimenhydrinate for nausea. For low blood sugar, IV D10W, with glucagon only if you can't get an IV. In opioid overdose, IV naloxone if the patient stays unconscious and apneic. In shock from bleeding, fluids and TXA. And nausea and vomiting has a whole PCP-only protocol, with dimenhydrinate and ondansetron.
slides.sayZh: 这是逐个流程对比的 EMR 与 PCP。左栏是所有执照级别，右栏是 PCP 增加的。哮喘或 COPD：加异丙托溴铵、地塞米松，病情严重时肌注肾上腺素。过敏性休克：病人持续低血压时加静脉补液，给肾上腺素后用沙丁胺醇处理支气管痉挛，再加苯海拉明。胸痛：建立静脉通路，恶心时给茶苯海明。低血糖：静脉给 D10W，开不了静脉才用胰高血糖素。阿片类过量：病人持续昏迷且无呼吸时静脉给纳洛酮。失血性休克：补液和 TXA。恶心呕吐则有一整套 PCP 专用流程，用茶苯海明和昂丹司琼。

slides.q: A COPD patient is still severely wheezy after salbutamol by nebulizer. Which PCP-only drug blocks the parasympathetic signal that tightens the airway?
slides.say: Here's a scope question. A COPD patient is still severely wheezy after salbutamol by nebulizer. Which PCP-only drug blocks the parasympathetic signal that tightens the airway? A, ipratropium. B, dexamethasone. C, diphenhydramine. D, epinephrine. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道执业范围题。一位 COPD 病人用雾化沙丁胺醇后仍然严重喘鸣。哪种 PCP 专用药能阻断让气道收紧的副交感信号？A 异丙托溴铵；B 地塞米松；C 苯海拉明；D 肾上腺素。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is A, ipratropium. It's an anticholinergic, so it blocks the parasympathetic tightening signal, and in BC it's a single dose, in the nebulizer with salbutamol. B, dexamethasone, is also PCP-only, but it's a steroid that calms inflammation, not a receptor blocker. C, diphenhydramine, is an antihistamine for allergic reactions. D, epinephrine, works the other way, by stimulating sympathetic receptors, and it isn't PCP-only: every licence level gives it IM, although using it for severe asthma is a PCP intervention.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 A，异丙托溴铵。它是抗胆碱药，能阻断副交感的收紧信号；在 BC 只给一次，和沙丁胺醇放在同一个雾化器里。B 地塞米松也是 PCP 专用，但它是平息炎症的类固醇，不是受体阻断剂。C 苯海拉明是治疗过敏反应的抗组胺药。D 肾上腺素作用方向相反，是兴奋交感受体的；它也不是 PCP 专用，所有执照级别都能肌注，只是用于严重哮喘属于 PCP 的处置。

slides.title: Their medications tell the story
slides.body:
The pill bottles are part of your history

  • A drug can reveal a condition the patient forgot or denied
  • Drugs change the picture: beta blockers hide tachycardia
  • Anticoagulants: expect more bleeding after trauma
  • Glaucoma drops: some PCP drugs need caution
  • Plan treatment around their drugs and interactions
slides.say: This is why classes matter, even for drugs you'll never give. Your patient's medications are part of the history. A patient may say he has no heart problems, but if you find a blood thinner and a nitroglycerin spray in his bag, you know a lot more. Medications also change what you see: a beta blocker can hide the fast pulse of shock, and an anticoagulant means a small fall can bleed a lot. Glaucoma eye drops matter too, because dimenhydrinate, diphenhydramine, and ipratropium all carry a glaucoma caution in BC. So read the bottles, then plan your treatment around them.
slides.sayZh: 这就是为什么要学药物类别，哪怕是你永远不会给的药。病人的用药就是病史的一部分。病人可能说自己心脏没问题，但如果你在他包里发现抗凝药和硝酸甘油喷雾，你就知道得多得多了。药物还会改变你看到的表现：β 受体阻滞剂可能掩盖休克时的快脉搏，吃抗凝药意味着一个小跌倒也可能大出血。青光眼眼药水也要留意，因为在 BC，茶苯海明、苯海拉明和异丙托溴铵都有青光眼方面的注意事项。所以先读药瓶，再围绕它们制定治疗。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Ondansetron: not with congenital long QT syndrome
  • Indigenous patients: ask about family long QT; if yes, dimenhydrinate
  • Diphenhydramine: not in newborns
  • Ipratropium: one dose only, always with salbutamol
  • Dexamethasone: not with a systemic fungal infection
  • TXA: not if over 3 hours, under 12, or isolated head injury
slides.say: Your seven PCP drugs bring new contraindications to learn cold. Ondansetron must not be given with congenital long QT syndrome, a heart rhythm condition. The BC monograph also asks you to check Indigenous patients for a personal or family history of long QT, and if there is one, to use dimenhydrinate instead. Diphenhydramine is contraindicated in newborns. Ipratropium is a single dose, always given with salbutamol, never alone. Dexamethasone is not for patients with a systemic fungal infection. And TXA has hard stops: more than three hours since the injury, a patient under twelve, or an isolated head injury. As an EMR you never carried these rules. Now they're part of your six rights.
slides.sayZh: 你的七种 PCP 药带来了新的禁忌症，要背得滚瓜烂熟。先天性长 QT 综合征（一种心律问题）的病人不能用昂丹司琼。BC 药物专论还要求你询问原住民病人本人或家族有没有长 QT 病史，如果有，就改用茶苯海明。新生儿禁用苯海拉明。异丙托溴铵只给一次，必须和沙丁胺醇一起用，不能单用。有全身性真菌感染的病人不用地塞米松。TXA 有硬禁忌：受伤超过三小时、未满十二岁、单纯颅脑外伤。当 EMR 时你不用背这些规则，现在它们都是你六个正确的一部分。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Most drugs here (fentanyl, midazolam, digoxin) are not BC drugs
  • Nitro: not if systolic < 110, or HR < 50 or > 150
  • Nitro: not within 24 h of Viagra or Levitra, 48 h of Cialis
  • ASA: 160 mg chewed; the only drug that doesn't need vitals first
  • Dexamethasone, adult: 8 mg, PO preferred (PCP)
  • Low blood sugar: IV sugar is D10W only, no D50W
slides.say: For the BC exam, remember that most drugs in this chapter, like fentanyl, midazolam, and digoxin, are not on the BC EMR or PCP list. Learn their classes for your assessment, not for your drug kit. Nitroglycerin is contraindicated if the systolic is under one hundred ten, or the heart rate is under fifty or over one hundred fifty. The book says to avoid nitro within twenty-four to forty-eight hours of an erectile dysfunction drug; BC is precise: twenty-four hours for Viagra or Levitra, forty-eight for Cialis. ASA is one hundred sixty milligrams, chewed, and it's the only drug that doesn't need vital signs first. Adult dexamethasone is eight milligrams, preferably by mouth. And BC's only IV sugar is D10W.
slides.sayZh: 备考 BC，记住本章大多数药，比如芬太尼、咪达唑仑和地高辛，都不在 BC EMR/PCP 药单上。学它们的类别是为了评估病人，不是为了放进你的药箱。收缩压低于一百一十，或心率低于五十、高于一百五十，禁用硝酸甘油。书里说用勃起功能障碍药后二十四到四十八小时内避免硝酸甘油；BC 规定得更精确：Viagra 或 Levitra 二十四小时内、Cialis 四十八小时内禁用。ASA 是一百六十毫克嚼服，也是唯一给药前不要求先测生命体征的药。成人地塞米松八毫克，首选口服。BC 唯一的静脉补糖是 D10W。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Learn the class: it predicts effects and side effects
  2. PCP adds new classes: anticholinergic, steroid, antihistamine, TXA
  3. Read the patient's meds: they reveal history and hide signs

Next: Chapter 8, vascular access and medication administration
slides.say: Let's wrap up Chapter 7. One: learn drugs by class, because the class predicts the main effect and the side effects. Two: as a PCP, the protocols give you new classes: an anticholinergic and a steroid for breathing, antihistamines and an antiemetic for allergy and nausea, IV dextrose for low sugar, and TXA for bleeding, each with its own contraindications. Three: read your patient's medications. They tell you the history, and they can hide the signs you rely on, like a beta blocker hiding the fast pulse of shock. Next, in Chapter 8, we'll put this into practice: starting IVs and giving medications safely. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 第 7 章收尾。一，按类别学药，因为类别能预测主要作用和副作用。二，作为 PCP，各个流程给了你新的药物类别：呼吸方面的抗胆碱药和类固醇，过敏和恶心方面的抗组胺药和止吐药，低血糖用的静脉葡萄糖，出血用的 TXA，每种都有自己的禁忌症。三，读懂病人的用药：它们告诉你病史，也可能掩盖你依赖的体征，比如 β 受体阻滞剂掩盖休克时的快脉搏。下一章，第 8 章，我们把这些用到实践中：建立静脉通路和安全给药。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
